args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and
tests/test_money.py specify ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Align the rounding mode
with FIN-212 so test_money passes.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the docstring and the tests (per FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This changes `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Example: `Decimal("2.665")` now rounds to `2.66` (half-even), matching `tests/test_money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: passed.
